---
title: "Keep config-level blocks across dev config reloads"
description: "Drop when the pinned release adds already sanitized blocks to config.blocks in sanitizeConfig."
---

<!-- Generated by `pnpm upstream export` from the patch's commit message on top of Payload v4.0.0-beta.2. Edit the commit, not this page. -->

After a Payload config edit in Vite dev, a site that defines a block in the
config's blocks array and references it by slug fails on every admin page
with "Block not found for slug", and Payload's reload fails in the Drizzle
schema build with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'name')".
The failed reload leaves getPayload waiting, so every later request hangs.
Vite re-evaluates the config module and its importers, but not the module
that exports the block, so the new config gets the block object that the
first sanitizeConfig call marked as sanitized. sanitizeConfig skipped such a
block without adding it to config.blocks, so the reloaded config had no
blocks for the Lexical BlocksFeature and the Drizzle schema to look up.

sanitizeConfig now adds an already sanitized block to config.blocks and only
skips sanitizing it again.

- **Patch:** `dev-reload-config-blocks`, committed as `fix(payload): keep config-level blocks across dev config reloads`
- **Upstream:** Not proposed
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run --project unit packages/payload/src/config/sanitize.spec.ts; e2e dev check (tests/dev/config-reload.spec.ts)`
- **Diff:** [`upstream/patches/0011-fix-payload-keep-config-level-blocks-across-dev-conf.patch`](https://github.com/AdiRishi/offload-cms/blob/main/upstream/patches/0011-fix-payload-keep-config-level-blocks-across-dev-conf.patch)
